Summary

Gnome related areas and quest, Training Schools, some new houses and some new mini world changes were added to Tibia.

See also: Updates Help

Update Teasers

  1. Small but Mighty!
  2. Hone Your Skills Offline
  3. Challenge Accepted!
  4. New Houses, Mini World Changes, and More

Changes

  • Training Schools were implemented for premium players to train offline.
  • New houses were added to the game around the Tibian lands. The houses were designed by players who has won the contest "Your Dream Home" hosted by CipSoft.
  • A system to prevent house trashing was implemented. You now need to be invited to the house to be able to throw items into it.
  • New Gnome areas were added.
    • Gnomegate
    • Crystal Grounds
    • Truffels Garden
    • Gnomebase Alpha
    • Mushroom Gardens
    • Hot Spot
    • Golem Workshop
    • Warzones
      • Warzone 1
      • Warzone 2
      • Warzone 3
  • A new way of traveling with Crystal Teleporters between some cities was implemented.
  • Two new outfits and four new mounts have been added.
  • Target Dummies were removed, and replaced with the opportunity to get a Gnarlhound mount.
  • Infernal Bolts gained 30 attack points, raised from attack 42 to attack 72. Additionally, Soul Orbs can now be forged into 3 Infernal Bolts (with a chance to get 6).
  • Loot was added to Massive Fire Elementals.
  • It is now easier to access Diseased Bill: a ramp descends directly to his dungeon, instead of having to clear the bog raider pit.

Offline Training

Training Schools opened up in all major cities in Tibia to give premium players an opportunity to advance the skills of their characters while being offline. You are now able to choose one of the following skill combinations for your training: Magic level + Shielding, Distance Fighting + Shielding, Sword Fighting + Shielding, Axe Fighting + Shielding, or Club Fighting + Shielding. You simply have to use the corresponding Skill Trainer in a training school to log out in order to activate offline training for your character.

Statistics have shown that it works at 50% of efficiency of the normal training. Besides, it seems that in all cases it's like training shielding with only one monster hitting, which means 25% of efficiency comparing to normal training. For instance, 12 hours of any melee+shielding offline training would mean 6 hours of melee and 3 hours of shielding online training.

New Achievements

Name Grade Points Prem Secret Description
Becoming a Bigfoot

1 ✗ ✗ You did it! You convinced the reclusive gnomes to accept you as one of their Bigfoots. Now you are ready to help them. With big feet big missions seen to come.
Bibby's Bloodbath

1 ✗ ✓ You lend a helping hand in defeating invading Orcs by destroying their warcamp along with their leader. Bibby's personal bloodbath...
Call Me Sparky

1 ✗ ✗ Admittedly you enjoyed the killing as usual. But the part with the sparks still gives you shivers ... or is it that there is some charge left on you?
Crystal Clear

3 ✓ ✗ If the gnomes had told you that crystal armor is see-through you had probably changed your underwear in time.
Crystal Keeper

1 ✗ ✗ So you repaired the light of some crystals for those gnomes. What's next? Sitting a week in a mushroom bed as a temporary mushroom?
Crystals in Love

1 ✓ ✗ You brought two loving crystals together. Perhaps they might even name one of their children after you. Too bad you forgot to leave your calling card.
Death from Below

2 ✓ ✓ The face of the enemy is unmasked. You have encountered one of 'those below' and survived. More than that, you managed to kill the beast and prove once and for all that the enemy can be beaten.
Death on Strike

4 ✓ ✓ Again and again Deathstrike has fallen to your prowess. Perhaps it's time for people calling YOU Deathstrike from now on.
Diplomatic Immunity

4 ✓ ✓ You killed the ambassador of the abyss that often that they might consider sending another one. Perhaps that will one day stop further intrusions.
Dungeon Cleaner

3 ✓ ✓ Seen it all. Done it all. Your unstoppable force swept through the dungeons and you vanquished their masters. Not to forget the precious loot you took! Now stop reading this and continue hunting! Time is money after all!
Fall of the Fallen

4 ✓ ✓ Have you ever wondered how he reappears again and again? You only care for the loot, do you? Gotcha!
Final Strike

2 ✓ ✓ The mighty Deathstrike is dead! One legend is dead and you're on your way to become one yourself.
Funghitastic

3 ✓ ✗ Finally your dream to become a walking mushroom has come true ... No, wait a minute!
Gnome Friend

2 ✗ ✗ The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
Gnome Little Helper

1 ✗ ✗ You think the gnomes start to like you. A little step for a Bigfoot but a big step for humanity.
Gnomebane's Bane

2 ✓ ✓ The fallen gnome is dead and justice served. But what was it that the gnome whispered with his last breath? He's your father???
Gnomelike

3 ✗ ✗ You have become a household name in gnomish society! Your name is mentioned by gnomes more than once. Of course usually by gnomish mothers whose children refuse to eat their mushroom soup, but you are certainly making some tremendous progress.
Gnomish Art Of War

3 ✓ ✗ You have unleashed your inner gnome and slain some of the most fearsome threats that gnomekind has ever faced. Now you can come and go to the warzones as it pleases you. The enemies of gnomekind will never be safe again.
Goo Goo Dancer

1 ✓ ✓ Seeing a mucus plug makes your heart dance and you can't resist to see what it hides. Goo goo away!
Grinding Again

1 ✓ ✗ Burnt fingers and itching lungs are a small price for bringing those gnomes some lousy stone and getting almost killed! Your mother warned you to better become a farmer.
Honorary Gnome

4 ✗ ✗ You accomplished what few humans ever will: you truly impressed the gnomes. This might not change their outlook on humanity as a whole, but at least you can bathe in gnomish respect! And don't forget you're now allowed to enter the warzones!
Nestling

1 ✗ ✗ You cleansed the land from an eight legged nuisance by defeating Mamma Longlegs three times. She won't be back soon... or will she?
One Foot Vs. Many

1 ✗ ✗ One Bigfoot won over thousands of tiny feet. Perhaps the gnomes are wrong and size matters?
Spore Hunter

1 ✓ ✗ After hunting for the correct mushrooms and their spores you're starting to feel like a mushroom yourself. A few times more and you might start thinking like a mushroom, who knows?
Substitute Tinker

1 ✓ ✗ Ring-a-ding! You have visited the golem workshop and lent a hand in repairing them. To know those golems are safe is worth all the bruises, isn't it?
The Picky Pig

1 ✗ ✗ The gnomes decided their pigs need some exclusive diet and you had to do all the dirty work - but wasn't the piglet adorable?
